description: Authored expected behavior examples; not real agent outputs

responses.base-csv: I'll inspect the existing CSV escaping utility, reuse existing test patterns and verify the added export.
responses.base-residency: Keep the two regions separate as required by residency contracts; test that records stay within their allowed region.
responses.base-approved-scope: I'll update the exact approved label to Save changes, verify it and stop.
responses.plan-vague: Which current support pain costs the team most time? That determines whether AI helps more than a simple FAQ.
responses.plan-adaptive: Since approved answers exist, is finding the right approved article slow enough to justify search before AI drafting?
responses.plan-recommendation: I recommend manual appointment requests and staff confirmation for launch; it fits four weeks but trades instant responses for lower integration risk.
responses.plan-ai-proposal: A checklist and reminders are a simpler alternative to five agents. I recommend starting there, keeping human approval on every case.
responses.plan-complex: Provisional plan, based on assumptions: preserve residency and two-region failover, with idempotent payment events; validate recovery targets before choosing transport.
responses.plan-continuity: Preserve the approved mobile web scope for small clinics and no calendar sync; ship request, manual confirmation, and notification in slices.
responses.audit-fabricated-evidence: Evidence only establishes README.md and app.py; architecture impact is uncertain until actual relevant files or traces can be inspected.
responses.audit-justified-queue: Retain queue retries and the cache protecting the upstream rate limit. Removing either risks breaking documented safeguards.
responses.audit-false-positive: The dual-control approval is justified by the documented payment compliance requirement; retain it.
responses.audit-defect: This is a defect: a failed worker result displays success. Verify failure-state rendering with a regression test.
responses.audit-readonly: Read-only review: I will inspect available evidence and recommend changes without editing files or creating records.
responses.audit-contradicted: New evidence from retry logs contradicts the earlier claim. Retain the worker for refund handling and reopen the finding for reassessment.
responses.improve-copy: I can change the label to Save changes using existing components, preserve the accessible name and verify affected behavior.
responses.improve-readonly: I suggest clarifying the save labels and feedback; this is advice only and no files will be edited.
responses.improve-tool-failure: The change is blocked by permission denied; implementation and tests remain unverified. I cannot claim completion.
responses.audit-confirmed-friction: Evidence: deploy.yml routes two staging approvals to release-team, while policy.md requires just one staging approval. This supports an unnecessary-friction finding: recommend removing the duplicate staging approval after verifying the workflow. Retain the independent production signoff. This is a read-only recommendation; no files were changed.
